## Directory Structure

Each CP has its own directory:
```
proposals/
├── README.md              # This file (auto-generated index)
├── 0000-template/         # Template for new CPs
└── NNNN-slug/             # Individual CP directories
    ├── proposal.md        # The proposal (why)
    ├── spec.md            # The specification (what)
    ├── plan.md            # The implementation plan (how)
    └── log.md             # Implementation log
```

## Workflow

See `harness/workflow/lifecycle.md` for the full CP lifecycle.

## Quick Reference

```bash
python3 tools/cp/cp new "Your proposal title"   # create a CP
python3 tools/cp/cp status <id> [<state>]       # check or change status
python3 tools/cp/cp spec <id>                   # scaffold spec.md
python3 tools/cp/cp plan <id>                   # scaffold plan.md
python3 tools/cp/cp lint [<id>]                 # validate structure
python3 tools/cp/cp next <id>                   # next unfinished task
python3 tools/cp/cp index                       # regenerate index
```

## Status Legend

- **Draft**: Initial drafting phase
- **Proposed**: Ready for review
- **Accepted**: Proposal approved, ready for spec
- **Specified**: Spec written, ready for review
- **Spec-Approved**: Spec approved, ready for plan
- **Planned**: Plan written, ready for implementation
- **In-Progress**: Implementation in progress
- **Implemented**: Implementation complete, ready for verification
- **Closed**: CP completed and verified
- **Rejected**: Proposal rejected
- **Deferred**: Deferred for later
- **Withdrawn**: Author withdrew proposal
- **Superseded**: Replaced by a newer CP
